notes: displaySourceText and displaySegments are absent on every cue because the recorded build never logged them; the overlay therefore renders these traces through the fallback branch of getCueDisplaySegments, which is the branch that actually ran for these sessions.
startedAt is recovered from the cue id itself (omni-cue-<unix millis>); endedAt is the wall clock of the log line that produced the frame, converted from the log's local +08:00 stamps.

The ST_SOURCE_ONLY / ST_NATIVE_TRANSLATION_COMMIT markers do not exist anywhere in this log (they were added to protocol.rs after it was recorded), and individual transcription.delta events are not logged either — only the final delta text survives, inside the [EVENT_CONTEXT] response.done line's lastAsrDelta field. Frames are therefore built from the states the log actually pins.
